Puncak Becici character

With Pinus Pengger, Puncak Becici is listed by Kalurahan Terong as a Dlingo pine destination. Both share the same highland landscape.

Detail

Connecting the two

  • Use a self-arranged vehicle.
  • Distance is approximate via hill roads; ask staff.
  • Pick one as the main point if time is limited.

Detail

When to choose Becici

If you want pine-landscape variety in one area, connect it with Pinus Pengger in half a day. See the comparison page to choose.

See the comparison page if unsure which to choose.

Frequently asked questions

Is Puncak Becici near Pinus Pengger?

Both are in the Dlingo pine belt; distance is approximate, ask staff or a map.

Which is better, Becici or Pengger?

It depends on preference; see the comparison page. They share a similar landscape.

Can it be reached by public transport?

Not directly; the hill stretch needs a separate vehicle. See the public-transport page.

How long to connect both?

Time varies by hill route; allow a buffer.
